instruction: Set auto-save to occur every 15 minutes in LibreOffice Impress to balance protection and performance

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 15 minutes. The evaluator verifies the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property is set to 15 in the LibreOffice configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches LibreOffice config file from the right path
Metric correctly parses XML and navigates to /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document path
Property name 'AutoSaveTimeIntervall' is correct (LibreOffice's official misspelling with double 'l')
Comparison logic correctly checks if interval equals 15 minutes
Complete instruction coverage - verifies the single requirement
Proper error handling for XML parse errors, missing files, and missing properties
Expected value (15) semantically matches instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: file fetch -> XML parse -> property extraction -> value comparison
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to ensure LibreOffice settings are saved/flushed before evaluation, though config files typically persist
Minor: Could add validation that the property exists with any value vs not being present at all (currently both return 0.0)
